name: Calm bedtime
instruction: Speak slowly, softly, and warmly, with restrained emotion and gentle natural pauses.

name: Warm storyteller
instruction: Use a warm, intimate storytelling tone with clear phrasing and unhurried transitions.

name: Gentle prayer
instruction: Speak reverently and gently, at a calm pace, with sincere warmth and quiet pauses.

name: Clear explainer
instruction: Speak clearly and patiently, with an approachable tone and steady pace.

instruction: Use a measured, authoritative documentary tone with crisp diction and controlled emotion.

name: Energetic promo
instruction: Use an energetic promotional delivery with punchy emphasis and rising momentum.
